title: Account settings

dataExport.description: Download a structured copy of your account, project, and crop library data as a JSON file.

publicProfile.description: This name belongs to your account and is shown as the author on every culture you have published, or will publish, to the crop library.
publicProfile.helperText: Without a name, your publications appear anonymous. If you set a name later, it automatically appears as the author on all cultures you already published – if you remove it again, those cultures appear anonymous once more. The name must be unique and not already used by someone else.

moderatorRequest.title: Help as a moderator
moderatorRequest.description: Help review proposals for new crop species and keep the crop library consistent.
moderatorRequest.alreadyModerator: You already have moderator rights for the crop library.
moderatorRequest.rejectedHint: You can send a new request if you still want to help.
moderatorRequest.motivationLabel: Why would you like to moderate?

security.noPasswordHint: This account signs in with Google or Microsoft and has no password. You can set one via "Forgot password" on the sign in page.

loginMethods.title: Login methods
loginMethods.description: These login methods are connected to your account.

deleteDescription: If you delete your account, it is deactivated immediately and anonymized after 14 days. Projects without remaining members are then deleted including project data; published crop library entries remain.
restoreDescription: You can undo the deletion within this period.
dialogWarning: Please confirm with your current password and the text "{{phrase}}". Your account will be deactivated and anonymized after 14 days. Projects without remaining members are then deleted.
dialogWarningWithoutPassword: Please confirm with the text "{{phrase}}". Your account is deactivated and anonymized after 14 days. Projects without remaining members are then deleted.
deletionScheduled: Your account has been scheduled for deletion. It will be anonymized on {{date}}.

errors.generic: The action could not be performed.

unsavedChangesWarning: There are unsaved changes. They will be lost when you leave the page.

emailConfirm.title: Confirm email change
emailConfirm.invalid: The confirmation link is invalid or has expired.

developer.title: Developer
developer.hintsDescription: Reset local development hints or show the first-project onboarding again. This does not delete projects or account data.

language.description: The interface language belongs to your account, not to a project. Other members of the same project can use OpenFarmPlanner in a different language at the same time. Content you type yourself — project, location and bed names — is never translated.

apiTokens.title: API tokens for external tools
apiTokens.description: Each token applies to one project only and can never change members, invitations, or account settings.
apiTokens.empty: You have not created any API tokens yet.
apiTokens.noProjects: You need to be a member of a project before you can create an API token.
apiTokens.revoked: The token "{{name}}" has been revoked and no longer works.

scopeHelp.read: May read the project's data. Cannot change anything.
scopeHelp.write: May read the project's data and create or update cultures. Cannot delete.
scopeHelp.delete: May additionally delete and restore cultures. Project members, invitations, account settings, and other administrative areas stay blocked.

form.name: Name
form.projectHelper: The token can only ever access this project. This cannot be changed later.
form.expiresAtHelper: Leave empty for a token without an expiry date. At most one year ahead.

created.title: Your new API token
created.warning: Copy the token now. It is shown this one time and cannot be retrieved again.
created.description: Store the token like a password, for example in your agent's secret storage. Never commit it to a repository. If you lose it, revoke it here and create a new one.
created.usageHint: Use it as an HTTP header: Authorization: Bearer <token>

cropLibraryToken.title: Crop library API token
cropLibraryToken.description: Superusers only: this token acts platform-wide and can write official crop species, synonyms, and regional names. It is not project-bound and separate from the API tokens above.
cropLibraryToken.empty: No crop library token has been created yet.
cropLibraryToken.revoked: The token "{{name}}" has been revoked and no longer works.

scopeHelp.read: May read official crop species, including pending proposals.
scopeHelp.write: May additionally propose and edit crop species (including synonyms and regional names). Approving, rejecting, and deleting stay blocked.

form.name: Name
form.expiresAtHelper: Leave empty for a token with no expiry date. At most one year in the future.

created.title: Your new crop library token
created.warning: Copy the token now. It is shown this one time and cannot be retrieved again.
created.description: Store the token like a password. Never commit it to a repository. If you lose it, revoke it here and create a new one.
created.usageHint: Use it as an HTTP header: Authorization: Bearer <token>
